hpx_shortcuts.py.summary: HpxShortcuts is a UI page class for the Android Smart app automation suite, extending the SmartFlow base class. This class encapsulates all interactions and verifications related to the HPX Shortcuts screen. It leverages Selenium WebDriver patterns, including explicit waits, robust timeout handling, and exception management (TimeoutException, NoSuchElementException, StaleElementReferenceException). The implementation adheres to the page object model, ensuring maintainable and organized test code. The 'flow_name' locator uniquely identifies this flow for test organization and reporting.

methods.description: Verify the title of the Shortcuts screen.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Maximum time to wait for the shortcuts screen title element
Flag to determine whether to raise exception on failure

methods.method_purpose: Waits for the shortcuts screen title element to appear within the specified timeout. If the element is not found, handles exceptions based on the 'raise_e' flag.
